positioning.headline: Developer Platforms & AI SDLC Architect @ Accenture
positioning.bio_en: I design developer platforms and engineering workflows that help teams build, secure and deliver software. My background spans software engineering, SRE, DevOps and platform engineering. Today, I focus on Developer Experience, GitHub Enterprise, CI/CD, engineering governance, and bringing AI agents into the software development lifecycle responsibly.
positioning.bio_es: Diseño plataformas y flujos de ingeniería que ayudan a los equipos a desarrollar, proteger y entregar software. Mi trayectoria combina ingeniería de software, SRE, DevOps y platform engineering. Mi foco actual es Developer Experience, GitHub Enterprise, CI/CD, gobernanza y la integración responsable de agentes de IA en el ciclo de vida del software.
